findings: Log and Sqrt are dedicated ggml operations; Softplus is a Unary; none is currently mapped by region.cc.
Rsqrt can use original Fill(1), Sqrt and Div in one managed region; cost includes two full intermediates and three dispatches.
Original Softplus and Tanh formulas lose small nonzero values in float32; model above is not a device measurement.
Log and Sqrt lack explicit common-contract negative-domain and signed-zero handling; this is not a claim that every GPU fails.
The existing SiLU(-Inf) correction remains; stable negative-tail handling must be shared by Unary and SwiGLU.
Packed and separate SwiGLU have original entry points; packed rows need not be split into two host-controlled kernels.
No same-contract dynamic Binary Min/Max entry was identified; scalar Clamp is not a substitute.
F01 conversion and byte-stride ownership stay with existing HYLE adapters; dtype/layout differences alone do not justify a new arithmetic kernel.
